mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM trips trip WHERE trip.user_id = #{userId} AND trip.status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING') AND trip.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM trip_countries country WHERE country.trip_id = trip.id AND country.is_deleted = 0 ) )
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM accounts account WHERE account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.is_active = TRUE AND account.is_deleted = 0 )
